# opwan_wireguard_key (Resource)

A WireGuard key pair generated locally, like `wg genkey`. Nothing is sent to opwan: pass `public_key` to `opwan_tunnel`. The private key is kept in the Terraform state (marked sensitive), so protect the state the same way you would the key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that, when changed, generate a new key pair. Use it to rotate the key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The public key.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The private key, base64.
- `public_key` (String) The public key, base64.
